title: Safe Resemblance, Silent Propagation: Limits of Text-Similarity Guardrails for AI Agent Safety
abstract: arXiv:2611.21520v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When AI agents relay information to one another, an output can preserve an injected instruction's effect on downstream agents even after its wording changes, yet legitimate quotation and template reuse can produce high textual overlap with the source, so text-similarity guardrails that attempt to flag the former risk conflating these two cases. We test this distinction using DonkeyRail, a public classifier combining BLEU, ROUGE-L, and METEOR features, deployed in a controlled three-agent email relay, defining a behavioral measure in which an output counts as functional (the injected procedure induces fresh computations in two subsequent agents) independent of the detector's score, alongside legitimate controls that explicitly authorize quotation and reuse. translated_title: 安全的相似，无声的传播：文本相似度防护机制在AI智能体安全中的局限性
translated_abstract: 当AI智能体相互传递信息时，即使措辞发生改变，一个输出仍可能保留被注入指令对下游智能体的影响；而合法的引用和模板复用又会与源文本产生高度的文字重叠，因此试图标记前者的文本相似度防护机制可能混淆这两种情况。我们使用DonkeyRail——一个结合BLEU、ROUGE-L和METEOR特征的公开分类器——在受控的三智能体邮件中继环境中测试这种区分，并定义了一种行为度量：无论检测器评分如何，只要被注入的程序能在两个后续智能体中引发新的计算，该输出即被计为“功能性”的；同时设置了明确授权引用和复用的合法对照组。在默认阈值下，该分类器漏检了19个功能性输出中的8个，同时误报了192个合法回复中的70个，且每一个完成的引用和模板复用回复都触发了……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过受控三智能体邮件中继实验证明，基于BLEU、ROUGE-L和METEOR特征的文本相似度防护机制（DonkeyRail）既漏检了措辞改变后仍保留注入指令效果的功能性输出（19个中漏检8个），又大量误报合法的引用与模板复用回复（192个中误报70个），揭示了文本相似度防护在AI智能体安全中的根本局限。
en_tdlr: Through a controlled three-agent email relay experiment, this paper shows that text-similarity guardrails (DonkeyRail) both miss functional outputs where injected instructions persist despite rewording (8 of 19 missed) and falsely flag legitimate quotation and template reuse (70 of 192 flagged), revealing the fundamental limits of text-similarity-based AI agent safety.
